title: One line of a session ledger, telemetry/events/<sid>.jsonl
description: Appended, never rewritten. ts, ns, event_id and sid are set by the writer. Lines are written by event.py and by the hooks, never by a session by hand.

event_id.description: unique per line; a line copied twice counts once

sid.description: <subject>-<UTC stamp>: one per session, and a parked session keeps its sid

kind.description: the mode the session runs in

ev.description: approve is written only by the gate hook; write and remove only by the journal

subject.description: what the session is about; sessions on one subject are grouped by it

parent.description: the sid of the session that opened this one

who.description: who the machine says is at the keyboard: declared, never proven

cause.description: why a person had to speak (touch) or what a wait is on (block); untagged until the close

prompt_origin.description: on a hook touch, where the prompt came from; absent when it could not be read

subtag.description: sharpens a cause, at most 40 characters

ask.description: on a block, the class of ask

by.description: who gave a touch its cause

source.description: the channel the work arrived by

prior.description: whether prior art was found before investigating

fp.description: <system>:<failure-class>, the typed fingerprint a repeat is found by

goal_met.description: on a done end, how the requester's goal was checked

modes_sha.description: on a start: a hash of the team's mode files

via.description: on an approve, how the yes was given

key.description: on an approve, the subject the yes names

ref.description: on an approve, the bridge reply or the grant

msg_sha.description: on a typed approve, the hash of the message read

sitting.description: on an approve, the assistant session

transcript.description: on an approve written before 0.3.1; no longer written, never read

proposal.description: on an approve of a proposal

text_sha.description: on an approve of a proposal, the hash of its text

path.description: on a write, remove or approve
